Patrick, saw Consolidated Communications pick Alianza to power its next-gen voice, on top of your Intelligent Communications Fabric push.

Wins like that open more in-market service providers than your team can cover before you can hire and ramp, and that gap is where pipeline goes cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Alianza off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?

Patrick, quick follow-up for Alianza.

With marquee wins pulling service provider interest, the target list grows faster than the team does. Most groups cannot say exactly how many meetings they need to hit the number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter gets tight.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Alianza needs to hit target this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Patrick, last bit of proof for Alianza.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Alianza's reply rate likely compares to other communications software companies. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?

Patrick, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Riding marquee wins through a busy roadmap is its own kind of full plate and timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I will tailor it to Alianza either way.
